newsitem.title: USA: CD Warehouse posts 1996 EPS of $0.10.
newsitem.headline: CD Warehouse posts 1996 EPS of $0.10.

text.p: CD Warehouse Inc, which completed its initial public offering in January, said it earned $175,959 or $0.10 a share in 1996 on a pro forma basis.
The company said it had limited operations from its formation in September to December 31, 1996. It reported revenues of $5,005,623.
The results include the company's January 27 acquisition of Compact Discs International for $3.2 million.
CD Warehouses franchises and operates stores which buy, sell and trade new and previously owned compact discs. As of March 14, there were 112 CD Warehouse stores in 25 U.S. states and in England.
